Requirements: R-10
Plan row: TS-12

## Given
A guest cart with one line of book A (stock 5), quantity 1. The update call is PUT /api/cart/{itemId} (Q2 reading a adopted; a PATCH run is added if the person answers b).

## Steps
1. Set the quantity to 5 (at stock), then GET /api/cart.
2. Set the quantity to 6 (one over), then GET /api/cart.
3. On the cart page change the quantity to 6 and look at the page.

## Then
1. P-atstock and P-overstock: the two updates get the answer that the raised question gives for stock and stock plus one.
2. After the refused update GET /api/cart (independent of the PUT answer) holds the stored quantity that the raised question gives.
3. The cart page shows the refusal in the way the raised question gives.
